Public saunas in Philadelphia, PA

Philadelphia's public sauna options grew in 2026. Bathhouse opened a large day-pass spa under the Bellevue in Center City in September, Fusion Spa & Resort in the Far Northeast runs a multi-room spa with a banya, Finnish saunas and a snow room, and Fiorst hosts shared wood-fired sauna sessions in the woods of the Schuylkill Center in Roxborough. Just over the city line, Chung Dam Spa in Cheltenham is a Korean-style spa with heated rooms and a steam bath. Prices vary by day and time at several venues, so confirm with each one before you go.

4 venues, each checked against the venue's own website on 2026-11-16. Fields we could not confirm are marked Unknown. Prices and hours change, so confirm before you go.

Schedule / who
Daily 8am-11:30pm. 18+. Walk-ins permitted, but reservations are strongly encouraged. Sauna Rituals (Aufguss) are hosted daily in the dry sauna.
Notes
Gas-furnace banya at 185-195°F, dry sauna up to 185°F with guided Aufguss sessions, infrared sauna at 135°F and a 115°F steam room, plus a hot pool (104°F) and a neutral pool (98°F). Bring a bathing suit and a non-glass water bottle; towels and slippers are provided. Massages are sold separately and include amenity access.

Fusion Spa & Resort

Far Northeast · 250 Byberry Rd, Philadelphia, PA 19116
Russian banyaSteam roomInfraredBathhouse

Up to 5 hours with a standard Spa Pass ($15 per additional hour; unlimited pass sold at checkout)

Schedule / who
Sun-Thu 10am-10pm, Fri-Sat 10am-11pm. Ages 16+ (under 18 must be with a parent or guardian at all times); ID and a card required at check-in. Book online for a set arrival time; walk-ins welcome based on availability.
Notes
Spa Pass covers a traditional banya, Finnish aroma sauna, panoramic dry Finnish sauna, Ganbanyoku stone-bed room, infrared and Himalayan salt rooms, Turkish hammam, aroma steam room, indoor and outdoor pools, jacuzzi, cold plunge and snow room, plus robe, towels, toiletries and a locker. Bring swimwear; robes are required in spa and restaurant areas. Phones not allowed in locker rooms or sauna areas. Pouring water on sauna heaters is not allowed. Free parking. Cancel at least 24 hours ahead to avoid charges.

Fiorst at the Schuylkill Center

Roxborough (Schuylkill Center for Environmental Education) · 8480 Hagy's Mill Road, Philadelphia, PA
Wood-firedOutdoor
Drop-in price
$50 per person for The Social Session (shared saunas); Bring-A-Friend add-on $25
Session length
90 minutes
Cold plunge
Cold plunge (included)
Schedule / who
Session dates and times are posted on the online booking calendar (Unknown otherwise). Private sessions also offered: $300 for one sauna (up to 8 guests) or $500 for both saunas (up to 16).
Notes
Hosted outdoor sessions in the Schuylkill Center woodlands; move between the saunas at your own pace, with a firepit between rounds. Bring swimwear, two towels (one to sit on in the sauna is mandatory), sandals, water and warm layers. Restrooms on site can be used for changing, but arrive ready to go. Snacks are fine by the firepit, not in the sauna. Full refund or free rescheduling with 48 hours' notice. A waiver is on the venue's site.
